mentions.name: PressPass AI Editor
mentions.description: A built-in AI editor for WordPress that makes it easy to improve your website. Originally aimed at online newspapers and now attracting interest from WordPress agencies. The first user is free.
mentions.audience: Online newspapers, with growing interest from WordPress agencies.
